title: Install or update a Mac App Store app
summary: Install a specific application from the Mac App Store using its numeric product ID. This command also updates the app if it is already installed.

steps.explain: Install or update an application using its exact numeric product ID. You can find the ID using 'mas list' or 'mas search'.

placeholders.name: PRODUCT_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric product ID of the app

steps.expect: The application downloads and installs or updates.

alternatives.explain: Upgrade a specific application using its numeric product ID.

placeholders.name: PRODUCT_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric product ID of the app

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to uninstall an app via mas. You must delete the app from the Applications folder in Finder.

warnings: Installing apps requires an active internet connection and a signed-in Apple ID.
